sectionControllers.glyphGeometry: Source 8-based Display/Text scales determine the pinned scene and N travel. Phone S uses a full-width container with the 8-derived height and preserveAspectRatio meet; it is not resized from the S viewBox width. Both masks split horizontally.
sectionControllers.playback: One owned per-window playback store controls ambient motion without disabling scroll navigation. Actual Framer compilation, variable font selection and native bindings require separate verification.
